nomouse.description: Do not grab mouse at startup

filesystems.description: Metados filesystem assignments (e.g., ["d:/atari/d_drive", "c:/atari/c_drive"]) — each element is a string mapping drive letter to path

emutos.description: Prefer EmuTOS for booting instead of TOS

swapide.description: Swap IDE drives for this session

gui.description: Open up SETUP GUI at ARAnyM startup

position.description: Position ARAnyM window on screen, e.g., "100,50"

keyboard.description: Pre-set keyboard layout and system language (ISO country code, e.g., "us", "fr")

halt.description: Halt ARAnyM when Linux guest tries to reboot
